dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Features multiple irregular, closed 'O' and open 'C' shaped light-intensity rings. The perimeters exhibit jagged, high-contrast edges with a sharp gradient transition from high-luminance pixels to the dark-intensity dorsal base.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Significant density of localized, solid high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily concentrated in the posterior dorsal region and interspersed between larger macro-annuli along the mid-body lateral line.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent obtuse triangle is formed by the centroids of the three largest mid-body macro-annuli. Additional smaller geometric polygons are visible when mapping the centroids of the higher-density blobs toward the posterior end.
